notes: The fireball is on the field for up to 60 frames (param_breath[1].life), which is what ends the hit -- its script never does. It hits once: connecting subtracts hit_frames, which is its whole life. Touching a wall also ends it.

moves.name: Neutral Special (Max)
notes: Damage comes from Breath — see Projectiles & Articles below.

HDR's charged Neutral Special, and the one of the two that fires a projectile. It is available once the fireball cooldown has run out: 900 frames (MAX_COOLDOWN, 15 seconds), reset to full on frame 4 of this move and again on every death, respawn and entry. Holding the ordinary fire breath stalls the countdown -- Bowser's counts back up while he breathes -- so breathing delays the next fireball. Training mode starts it ready, and a flame in the mouth says it is.
Uses animation speed changes; frames shown are real frames.

moves.name: Air Dodge
notes: FAF is HDR's runtime calculation rather than a param: the air dodge stalls for 28 frames and ends once the fighter has fallen 35 units, so it follows their gravity and fall speed.
Intangible on frames 4-26.
Landing lag is 10 frames, from common's `landing_frame_escape_air` — the param HDR's air dodge status hands the landing when the dodge ends on the ground.
